sources.name: Fiji One News
sources.notes: Fiji Television Limited identifies itself as the operator of Fiji One and this news website; the February 2026 stock-exchange announcement corroborates the broadcaster and its public news role. National broadcaster and Pacific audience. No specific province-wide reporting beat is established by its national distribution or Suva headquarters. No published restrictive automation term was found in the reviewed pages. Attempted /privacy-policy/ returns 404. Public RSS is admitted only for attributed title/link/date discovery; all incident and geographic claims still require review.

sources.name: Fiji Meteorological Service
sources.notes: The government meteorological domain advertises this weather-alert RSS directly. NFA independently links the official meteorological domain. Weather-alert context for Fiji; exact affected areas must come from each issued warning, not a nationwide publisher assignment. The live RSS response is valid and empty. Its issuance/update/cancellation behavior and detection latency have not been replay-tested. Empty warnings are not a statement that all locations are safe.

sources.name: Fiji Government News
sources.notes: Official Fiji government portal with government announcements; NFA also links this government domain. Homepage explicitly advertises RSS. National government releases, not a comprehensive police, transport or village incident register. General announcements include non-incidents and international affairs. New records remain discovery candidates; no publication date is silently treated as an event date.

sources.name: National Fire Authority of Fiji
sources.notes: First-party statutory fire authority describes its establishment and national fire-services responsibility and publishes divisional emergency-communications pages. Explicit Northern, Western and combined Central/Eastern emergency-communications responsibilities; contacts do not establish current published incident coverage for each province. RSS parses but newest item is 11 June 2025, before the requested past-year baseline. Held as a stale official directory/feed; no current alert-delivery claim. Contact numbers were not operationally tested.

sources.name: The Fiji Times
sources.notes: Terms identify Fiji Times Limited as operator. The retrieved /about-us/ instead contains a generic authored post and casino material, so that page is excluded as publisher-identity evidence. National paper; no current province-specific beat is admitted in this review. Both attempted and advertised RSS URLs redirect to homepage HTML. Terms expressly prohibit automated scripting/software and restrict reuse for another publication/site. Held manual-only; no further automated collection.

sources.name: Fijivillage
sources.notes: Its terms state ownership and operation by Communications Fiji Limited; the company site separately identifies its Fijivillage news platform. National and community reporting; no explicit complete beat for every indexed province is established. Attempted /rss.xml returns 404. Terms permit personal/non-commercial research copying but require permission for other use and prohibit unauthorized caching/hypertext links. No publication/automated discovery admission is made; this is a source-review reference only.

sources.name: Fiji Sun
sources.notes: Sun (Fiji) News Limited is the operator identified in its terms. The publisher advertises this Google News sitemap in robots.txt. Collect attributed title, link and publication date only; no article contents, paywall or disallowed API access. All findings remain unverified discovery candidates; no automatic crime, event-time or geographic verification. Named newsroom hubs are partial remits and do not establish coverage of every province or locality.

sources.name: Fiji Police Force
sources.notes: NFA links police.gov.fj as Fiji Police and lists police stations in its emergency directory. Native HTTPS/HTTP retrieval attempts timed out. National police channel; station contacts are not a verified public incident feed or exact province coverage. Homepage and robots are currently unavailable from the review environment. Feed access, reuse conditions, publication freshness and platform activity remain unverified. Catalog identity reviewed from the complete NFA homepage crosslink, retrieved 2026-10-06T01:05:43Z; this date does not verify police website delivery or live updates.

sources.name: Fiji National Disaster Management Office
sources.notes: NFA names NDMO in its emergency directory. Official-domain disaster-plan URL was discovered, but native homepage/robots/PDF requests timed out; the directory links a different older dismac.org domain. National disaster coordination reference only. Do not infer verified local update feeds from an agency title. Current domain delivery and document contents were not verified by complete native retrieval. Remains a disabled directory; no source-to-province monitoring claim.
